Ni-Ne.prompt: When a situation is still forming, which is more you?
Ni-Ne.aText: I wait until one inner picture of the outcome has settled, even if I cannot yet show the steps.
Ni-Ne.bText: I keep several outer possibilities in play and move among them while the field is still open.

Ni-Ne.aText: A direction that arrives whole — as if I had already seen the end of the story.
Ni-Ne.bText: What the situation could become once I have turned it around in the outer field.

Ni-Ne.prompt: After you have seen something clearly, what happens to the other options?
Ni-Ne.aText: Further options feel like noise. I would rather follow the one unfolding vision.
Ni-Ne.bText: Once a possibility has been realized, my interest often moves on to the next one that is not yet real.

Ni-Ne.prompt: Where do you go to find the pattern?
Ni-Ne.aText: I withdraw from the room. The pattern is an inner image, not a fact on the table.
Ni-Ne.bText: I stay with the room. The next connection is in the objects and people themselves.

Ni-Ne.prompt: How does the future usually appear to you?
Ni-Ne.aText: As one trajectory — a single inner conviction of where things are tending.
Ni-Ne.bText: As a field of forks — many paths that are not yet real, scented at once.

Si-Se.aText: The impression a thing leaves in memory and body — how this kind of moment has felt before.
Si-Se.bText: The thing as it is now: texture, timing, impact, what can be done in front of me.

Si-Se.prompt: How do you judge whether a situation can be trusted?
Si-Se.aText: By whether it matches what I have already lived — precedent and familiarity.
Si-Se.bText: By what can be seen, touched, and done in this moment, before a theory about it.

Si-Se.prompt: When a new scene opens, when does it feel complete?
Si-Se.aText: When I have compared it with an inner standard of how such things feel and have gone.
Si-Se.bText: When I have taken it as it is given — the object, not my history of the object.

Si-Se.prompt: If you have to move, what do you return to?
Si-Se.aText: What has already proved itself in my experience.
Si-Se.bText: What is actually happening, even if I have no precedent for it.

Si-Se.aText: The present is incomplete until the inner sensory texture has been consulted.
Si-Se.bText: The present is enough. I trust concrete actuality more than the impression it leaves.

Ti-Te.aText: When the inner model is consistent — the idea must be true, even if it is not yet useful.
Ti-Te.bText: When it works in the shared world — facts others can check, a result that can be arranged.

Ti-Te.aText: A precise idea that is not yet useful, rather than a formula that is merely efficient.
Ti-Te.bText: A formula that produces a result, rather than an elegant idea that cannot be arranged.

Ti-Te.prompt: What do you notice first when a plan is wrong?
Ti-Te.aText: That a collective standard is logically hollow, even if everyone is using it.
Ti-Te.bText: That an inner theory fails to organize the facts and measures others can see.

Ti-Te.prompt: What has to line up before you will act?
Ti-Te.aText: The definition. It has to be true for me.
Ti-Te.bText: The data. Metrics and outcomes have to hold in common.

Ti-Te.aText: Refining the idea until it holds, whether or not it is yet a procedure.
Ti-Te.bText: Arranging people, plans, and measures until the outcome holds.

Fi-Fe.prompt: How do you know a choice is right?
Fi-Fe.aText: It matches a private standard of worth, even if I cannot display that standard.
Fi-Fe.bText: The feeling-tone among the people involved can hold.

Fi-Fe.prompt: What happens when the group’s mood pulls the other way?
Fi-Fe.aText: It does not change what I consider right.
Fi-Fe.bText: A logically neat choice still feels unfinished if it injures the group.

Fi-Fe.prompt: How do your values usually show?
Fi-Fe.aText: They are intense and often hard to display — loyalty to an inner image of worth.
Fi-Fe.bText: They show in how I keep relation possible — custom, morale, what “one” does.

Fi-Fe.prompt: If authenticity and harmony part ways, which do you keep?
Fi-Fe.aText: Authenticity. I remain with the inner image even if it looks like indifference.
Fi-Fe.bText: Harmony. I adapt value to the situation so that relation remains possible.

Fi-Fe.prompt: Which test do you actually use?
Fi-Fe.aText: Does this remain true to what I hold, whether or not the room agrees?
Fi-Fe.bText: Can the people involved still stand together after this is done?

Fi-Ti.prompt: When a decision is finished, what actually finished it?
Fi-Ti.aText: It matches a private standard of worth, even if I cannot prove that standard to anyone.
Fi-Ti.bText: The inner model is consistent. The idea holds, whether or not it is kind.

Fi-Ti.prompt: What bothers you first when something is wrong?
Fi-Ti.aText: That it violates what I hold, even if the logic is neat.
Fi-Ti.bText: That it is logically hollow, even if everyone feels fine about it.

Fi-Ti.prompt: If you cannot satisfy both, which do you keep?

Fi-Ti.aText: A felt yes or no that I may not be able to display.
Fi-Ti.bText: A definition or distinction that has to hold together.

Fi-Ti.aText: A clever argument still feels unfinished if it injures what I value.
Fi-Ti.bText: A sincere feeling still feels unfinished if the idea does not hold together.

Fe-Te.prompt: When a plan is finished, what made it finished?
Fe-Te.aText: The people involved can still stand together. Relation has been kept.
Fe-Te.bText: The result can be arranged and checked. The work produced what it said it would.

Fe-Te.prompt: What do you notice first when a group effort is failing?
Fe-Te.aText: Morale and the feeling-tone have broken, even if the metrics still look tidy.
Fe-Te.bText: The procedure is not producing, even if everyone still feels loyal to it.

Fe-Te.prompt: If you cannot satisfy both, which do you keep?
Fe-Te.aText: Harmony — a conclusion that injures the room is not finished.
Fe-Te.bText: Effectiveness — a conclusion that cannot be arranged is not finished.

Fe-Te.aText: The atmosphere: who is included, what “one” does, whether the group can continue.
Fe-Te.bText: The shared world: people, plans, and measures so that an outcome happens.

Fe-Te.aText: Can we still stand together after this is done?
Fe-Te.bText: Did this work, in facts others can check?

Ni-Si.aText: An inner picture of where this is tending — the end of the story, not yet in the room.
Ni-Si.bText: The impression this kind of moment has already left in memory and body.

Ni-Si.prompt: When the outer facts are incomplete, what do you trust?
Ni-Si.aText: A direction that arrives whole, as if I had already seen the pattern.
Ni-Si.bText: Precedent — how such things have gone, and whether this matches that texture.

Ni-Si.prompt: What makes a new scene feel known?
Ni-Si.aText: I sense the trajectory. Further options feel like noise once the vision has settled.
Ni-Si.bText: I have compared it with what I have already lived. Familiarity is the test.

Ni-Si.prompt: Which inner object do you follow?
Ni-Si.aText: The image of what is coming.
Ni-Si.bText: The stored impression of what has been.

Ni-Si.aText: Events interest me as signs of a pattern I cannot yet point to.
Ni-Si.bText: Events interest me as they compare with a standard I have already felt.

Ne-Se.prompt: What do you notice first in the room?
Ne-Se.aText: What the situation could become — paths that are not yet real.
Ne-Se.bText: What the situation is — texture, timing, impact, what can be done now.

Ne-Se.aText: The unused door. Once a possibility is realized, my interest often moves on.
Ne-Se.bText: The given moment. I trust what can be seen, touched, and done more than a theory about it.

Ne-Se.prompt: If you have to move, where do you go?
Ne-Se.aText: Toward the next connection between things that have not been linked yet.
Ne-Se.bText: Toward what is actually happening, before a possibility about it.

Ne-Se.prompt: Which field do you stay in?
Ne-Se.aText: The field of outer options while it is still open.
Ne-Se.bText: The field of concrete actuality — the object as it is.

Ne-Se.aText: I scent what could be true.
Ne-Se.bText: I take what is true in front of me.
